title: Rust Borrowing
learning_objectives: Use immutable borrows to read owned values without moving them.
Choose borrowed parameters when a function does not need ownership.
Recognize borrow checker errors caused by conflicting access.
explanation: Borrowing lets code inspect data through references while the owner keeps control of the value.

examples.title: Borrow to inspect text

compiler_error_examples: error[E0502]: cannot borrow as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable
completion_criteria: Learner can explain why reading through a borrow preserves ownership
